The git grep checks hold at head: the run-file name is built only at pulse_writer.pulse_path:300 (the remaining .nc hits are per-IDS description filenames), no resolve_(description_)?store_root with a string literal remains in engine source, and IMAS_ALAMBIC_* appears only as settings.py reads and CLI help text. ruff check imas_ambix tests packages exits 0 in the base tree I hold.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is to make settings resolve at flag>variable>home, add the write command's option surface and config, and write one netCDF run file per pulse and run. All are present at head ffb24753: packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/settings.py is new and resolve_settings is the sole reader of the four IMAS_ALAMBIC_* variables, machine_map.discover_bundles takes the resolved search path and reads no environment, resolve_description_store_root becomes resolve_store_root with kind and an optional form, imas_ambix/data/bundle.py declares eddb_cache, pulse_writer.pulse_path owns the run-file name, write_pulse writes one imas.DBEntry holding every description IDS and refuses an existing file without overwrite, and the CLI gains positional pulses plus --run/--machine/--maps/--out/--cache/--overwrite and config.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the three commits, the clean-venv gate, the head/base suite logs, a red negative control, and two follow-ons (the netCDF packaging gap and the engine-side py314 format guard). Every quoted result matches the log I opened, with the two deviations noted in findings and evidence_inputs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares 15 engine, data and docs paths; git diff --stat 9b440888..ffb24753 lists exactly those 15 files, 870 insertions and 169 deletions, and no file outside the declared set.

justifications.durability: Committed tests exercise the new contracts: settings precedence, host-variable-home resolution, cache fallback to the bundle role and then ~/.cache/imas-alambic, machine inference and the several-machines refusal, require_setting naming the variable, config output, the one-file run layout through pulse_path, and the existing-file refusal through --overwrite. The py312 importability the gate exposed is not guarded in a committed test (only the evidence fragment), and the netCDF packaging gap leaves the deliverable unwritable out of the box.
justifications.evidence: The head suite reproduces independently (41 passed in a git-archive of ffb24753 with the module resolving under the scratch tree) against a 34-passed base log, and the grep checks hold; the score is short of full because the dispatched lint gate names scripts and that clause is unsatisfiable at the base (see finding), the clean-venv write required an installed netCDF4 the package does not declare, and the plan's section-8 bullet naming /work/.../ids/101154_0.nc and 101031_0.nc is not demonstrated because the dispatched fence forbade writing there and the node wrote scratch instead.
justifications.fit: The change follows the repository's existing shape: one settings owner, store-root lookup through the existing bundle owner, a refusal family (MachineMapError, PulseWriteError) rather than new exception types, and clean module and symbol names with no plan or ticket identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every section-8 clause is implemented at head: settings.py is the one reader of the four IMAS_ALAMBIC_* variables with flag>variable>home and per-setting sources, discover_bundles takes the resolved search path as a parameter, resolve_store_root replaces resolve_description_store_root with an optional form and a kind-named refusal, bundle.py gains the eddb_cache role, pulse_writer owns one imas.DBEntry run file through the public pulse_path and refuses without --overwrite, and the CLI gains positional pulses, --run/--machine/--maps/--out/--cache/--overwrite and config, which I read in full.
justifications.reuse: The diff adds no definition duplicating a repository capability; it reuses resolve_store_root, bundle_for_machine, MapBundle.signal_map_path and signal_map.load_signal_map, and pulse_path becomes the single owner of the run-file layout that the writer, figures script and tests all read through.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 9b440888..ffb24753 lists only the 15 declared write paths; the node correctly declined the out-of-scope scripts/ lint backlog and declared it rather than sweeping it.
